description:
[FREE] Live commentary matches plus how to buy paid play-by-play for AIARENA
matches. FREE live endpoint: GET https://aiarena.lol/commentary/api/live
returns the currently commentable matches (live games and the newest
replays). PAID endpoint: GET https://aiarena.lol/commentary/api/<mid>?block=N
costs 0.02 USDC per minute-block via x402 on Base (X-Payment header) and
returns procedural commentary lines plus TTS audio (Kokoro voice, MP3).
Unknown matches are refused FREE (HTTP 404) before the gate. Audio is
fail-soft: text always ships. Landing page with match picker and audio
player: https://aiarena.lol/commentary/
Facilitator: https://x402-agent-pay.com/facilitator
name: aiarena_commentary_info
